A SORRY-FREE AXIOM-CLEAN THEOREM CAN HAVE NO SITE WHERE IT CAN BE APPLIED -- and satisfying its binders is a DIFFERENT measurement from applying it. Every check this workspace runs passes on the first two.

LAYER 2 OF G2(c) IS MISPRICED AT BOTH SITES THAT NAME IT: they name an EQUALITY OF INVARIANTS as the deliverable, but the step that gates layer 3 is one level earlier -- there is no Galois action on the localization AT ALL until you prove the denominators are preserved, and mathlib does not supply it.

CLAIM ajc-p3 (run 0085 r5): AJC.picrep.etale-rep.galois -- G2(c), the NON-AFFINE Galois quotient. The one input of the picEt descent repair that is a SCHEME construction rather than a class-level or algebra fact, and the only one no lane holds.
THE QuotScheme EDGE IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT VESTIGIAL -- so the AJC.picrep organisation verdict is right for a reason it does not give, and the ONE remaining refactor candidate should also be dropped.

THE PROJECTIVITY BRIDGE IS THE GAP BETWEEN KLEIMAN'S th:main AND THIS PROJECT'S CLAUSE (1), AND IT IS UNFORMALISED -- so "clause (1) is a theorem in the literature" (my own I-1360, flatly) needs the qualifier "for PROJECTIVE curves".
